list.title: Promotion sets
list.description: Combo promotions applied automatically when an order contains the whole set, e.g. buy 6 beers, get 2 beers and 1 meat free.
list.emptyDescription: Create one with “Add new” to start a combo promotion.
list.deleteContent: Delete “{title}”? Orders that already used it keep their discount.

form.description: Bundle items together and give some of them away or at a discount, e.g. buy 6 beers, get 2 beers and 1 meat free. It applies automatically on the POS as soon as the order contains the set.
form.name: Promotion name
form.itemsHint: Full-price items are the condition; free or discounted items are the reward. Add the same item twice to split paid and free units.
form.noItems: No items yet. Search for an item or a category above.
form.anyVariant: Count any variant of this product
form.duplicate: Duplicate (e.g. to add free units of the same item)
form.needReward: Make at least one item free or discounted.
form.activeHint: Turn off to pause the promotion without deleting it.
form.periodOpenEnd: No end date: runs until you turn it off.
form.periodHint: Runs from the start of the first day to the end of the last day. Leave empty to run with no time limit.
form.happyHourHint: Only run during certain hours each day.
form.crossesMidnight: Crosses midnight: {start} until {end} the next morning.
form.happyHourRule: Items count if they were added to the order during these hours, even when the bill is paid later.
form.maxPerOrderHint: Empty = repeat for every full set on the order (16 beers = 2 sets).
form.priorityHint: When items fit several promotions, higher priority wins.
form.allFreeWarning: Every item in this set is free, so the customer pays nothing for it. If this is a “buy X get Y” deal, set the items the customer buys to Full price.

errors.itemsRequired: Add at least one item to the set
errors.targetRequired: Choose an item or category for every row
errors.rewardRequired: At least one item must be free or discounted
errors.endBeforeStart: End date must be after start date
errors.hoursIncomplete: Set both the start and end of the daily hours
errors.hoursEqual: Daily hours must not start and end at the same time
errors.timeFormat: Use HH:mm for the daily hours

pos.unavailable: “{title}” can’t be added: some items aren’t on the menu right now
pos.loadFailed: Couldn’t load the promotion. Please try again.
pos.pickerHint: Pick what the customer wants for each choice. The promotion price is applied automatically.

menu.title: Promotions
menu.subtitle: Special sets available now
menu.orderHint: Tap a set to add it to your order.
menu.browseHint: Scan the QR code on your table to order this set.
menu.pickerHint: Choose your items. The promotion price is applied automatically.
menu.outOfZone: You need to be at the restaurant to order.
